title: SpriteFrikandel
body:
# Recipes

- Horses drop `Raw Horse Meat`
- `Raw Horse Meat` can be cooked in a furnace or blast furnace into `Cooked Horse Meat`

- Crafting `Raw Frikandel`:
  - `Raw Chicken`
  - `Raw Porkchop`
  - `Raw Beef`
  - `Raw Horse Meat`
  - Result: `8 Raw Frikandel`
(uniform)
- `Raw Frikandel` can be cooked in a furnace or blast furnace into `Frikandel`

- Crafting `Sprite`:
  ```text
   I x x
   I x x
   S x x
  ```
  - `I` = Iron Ingot
  - `S` = Sugar

(can be placed left, middle, or right. it doesn't matter)

- Crafting `Spritefrikandel`:
  - `Frikandel`
  - `Sprite`
  - Result: `Spritefrikandel`
(uniform)
